scientific_integrity: The analytical proof, definitions, assumptions and boundary regimes are in RESULT.md. The standalone checker supplies finite exact and numerical supporting checks but is not an infinite theorem certificate. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: No pointwise critical a=2 tail coefficient is claimed.
Generality is restricted to geometric emigration and critical geometric offspring.
Older general branching-migration literature may still bear on historical priority.
title: A Gamma-square stationary tail law for geometric emigration without post-reproduction immigration
